services.name: Big Tiki Boat | 1.5 hrs
services.desc: Our newest Tiki Boat is one of a kind, specifically built for Florida Tiki Tours. It holds up to 18 guests, has a restroom, a custom 1,000 watt Bluetooth compatible sound system and state of the art lighting. Individual seats can be booked as part of a public tour, or the entire boat can be booked privately for your group. Daytime tours are 1.5 hours, and we also offer a 2 hour sunset tour. If you don't see a time/spot available online that accommodates your needs, please call us at 727-418-6070. We supply a cooler with ice, but nothing is for sale on the boat.
